content: whisper.cpp mobile: RAM = weights + KV cache + compute buffers; tiny ~200-273 MB, base ~350-390 MB, small ~850-900 MB (disk 75/142/466 MiB). Android runs CPU-only and is much slower than iOS (issue 959); sustained 15-min transcription risks thermal throttling; streaming latency grows over time causing ANR/process kills (discussion 3567). Quantized models ~42-75 MB cut memory bandwidth.
